sources.title: Text translation prebuilt AI model - AI Builder | Microsoft Learn
sources.snippet: The text translation prebuilt model translates your text data in real time across more than 60 languages. This prebuilt model could help remove language barriers within your company. The text translation model can also detect the language of the text data you want to translate.

sources.title: Translate - AI at Meta
sources.snippet: Translate is an open source project based on Facebook's machine translation systems. It uses a sequence-to-sequence model, and is based on fairseq-py, a sequence modeling toolkit for training custom models for translation, summarization, dialog, and other text generation tasks.
